name: NATO Crossed Swords
description: NATO's advanced live cyber red-team exercise for technical cyber operators and commanders. Tests offensive cyber capabilities and defensive responses against sophisticated adversaries in realistic, complex environments. Focuses on integrating cyber operations with broader military command and control, requiring improvised tactical decisions under adversarial pressure.
reputation: NATO's premier advanced offensive and defensive cyber integration exercise
notes: Complements Locked Shields by emphasizing technical cyber operator skills and offensive-defensive interplay. Participation is highly restricted to vetted NATO cyber operators.
